catalogue.note: Read from Figma at real size (375×800, nothing scaled): auto-layout frames are flex with Figma’s direction, gap, padding and alignment, everything else sits at its Figma offset, and all 42 boxes land on Figma’s to 0.05px. Square-cornered: the frame’s own 16px corners are left off and the diff leaves the four corners out (308 pixels). The account numbers are Satoshi with tabular lining figures, not a monospace face. Bank logo, round check and back chevron are Figma’s SVG export. The two-column card has a 1px inside stroke of black at 2%, drawn as an inset shadow. The naira sign is not in Satoshi (the files on this Mac hold no U+20A6) and Figma draws it from a fallback face: each one is Figma’s own outline of the glyph, inline, 0.572em wide. The iOS status bar is Figma’s SVG export: the time (SF Pro Text Semibold 17) as Figma’s outline, signal, wifi and battery as its vectors. Baselines: Figma rounds a line’s baseline to a whole pixel where Chrome rounds ascent and descent apart; the ten 12px lines of the two-column card sit 1px lower than Chrome puts them. The offsets are Figma’s baseline (its render bounds plus the glyph height from the font file) minus Chrome’s, not fitted to the picture. What is left in the diff is glyph and curve edges: Figma’s rasteriser against Chrome’s. Flat fills match exactly.
